conversation.said: If your lot don't score in the next ten minutes, you're wearing a Harbour City shirt next week. Deal?
Deal. And if we do score, you're wearing ours.
Whitcombe is going to score twice today, you watch.
Whitcombe? He couldn't score in a brewery.
Your back four look shaky already.
Says you, your keeper's been lucky all season.
Lucky? He's the best in the league, mate.
要是我们先进球，你下周就穿我们的蓝白围巾，拍张自拍给我。
行啊，那要是我们先进，你就唱两句我们的队歌。
We'll finish above you this season, guaranteed.
Fine, whoever finishes lower buys the other a pint of lemonade. Shake on it?
